verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs describe per-connection sync schedules with three Schedule Types: Scheduled (interval), Cron for precise times of day or month, and Manual. Chained dbt Cloud transformations can run after syncs, and the API supports external orchestration such as Airflow. Pricing references 15-minute sync frequency. missing for 10: scheduling covers data syncs only, not general workflows; no explicit evidence that schedules can be set programmatically by an agent via API or Terraform; no independent or hands-on corroboration of scheduling.
